editions.summary: Sample edition from the day before.

American Express says it will cut about 3,500 jobs even as profits climb, a sign that efficiency drives are reaching well-paid corporate roles. In watches, the Windup fair in New York had its biggest year yet, and SPIEL Essen opened in Germany with nearly every ticket gone. Anthropic began inviting users to an AI agent that works in the background, while Meta paused chat sharing in its Muse assistant after private chats turned up online.
